## Two layers of software-defined networking

<span id="ch1.intro1.2"/> gives you the full spectrum, from classic VLAN segmentation to enterprise SDN, capabilities the bank used to pay a separate closed-source SDN license for:

| Layer | Technology | Use tonight |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| L2 / VLAN bridging | **<span id="assignment.2.14"/>** | The vault VLAN isolating the database |
| SDN / isolated overlay zones | **<span id="assignment.2.13"/>** | Private subnets with no external path, even overlapping CIDRs |



## 🎯 Your Quest Objectives

1. Connect a closed-loop physical network for production
2. Build an equally isolated SDN for development
3. Learn how to move VMs into the new networks



🔐 Login Credentials
====================
